open_points.subject: retained migration export versus the one-home rule
open_points.text: R0-89 says “the owner keeps the export file ... until a checked backup holds the import”, while R0-80 says the customer’s living personal data is “held only by Registry” and admits only issued documents and Client Portal’s offline projection as kept copies.
open_points.question: Is the retained migration export a temporary exception to the one-home rule, and if so, what exact period and governance record authorize that exception?
options: Declare the export a temporary migration exception until the checked backup contains the import
Treat the one-home target as unmet until the export is destroyed
Change the export so it contains no living personal data
open_points.default_guess: Treat it as a temporary migration exception recorded in governance until the checked backup contains the import.

open_points.subject: storage of retained migration materials
open_points.kind: unnamed external store and trust boundary
open_points.text: “the owner keeps the export file and the picks, names and aliases given in the import”
open_points.question: What named system or medium holds these materials, who can access it, and what protection applies while it contains production personal data?
options: The owner’s password-vault or secured document store
open_points.default_guess: Keep them in owner-controlled encrypted storage accessible only to the owner.

open_points.subject: disposal of retained migration materials
open_points.text: “the owner keeps the export file and the picks, names and aliases given in the import until a checked backup holds the import” does not say what happens to them after that point.
open_points.question: After a checked backup contains the import, must the retained export and import choices be securely deleted, archived under a stated retention rule, or left at the owner’s discretion?
options: Securely delete them at that point
Retain them under an explicit governance period
Leave their disposal outside the product boundary
open_points.default_guess: Securely delete them once the checked backup is confirmed to contain the import.

open_points.subject: owner record used to replay retention actions
open_points.text: “What the owner repeats after a restore — erasures, restrictions, ends of a relationship — follows the owner’s own record of the retention review”
open_points.question: What named record holds these decisions, which identifiers and outcomes must it contain, who maintains it, and what happens when it is missing, incomplete or unavailable after a restore?
options: The Registry audit log preserved independently of the restored store
open_points.default_guess: Use a governance retention-review record outside Registry containing stable customer or project identifiers, the action, date and outcome; stop manual replay and reconcile explicitly if it is unavailable.
